author_claim: SmartProbe generates effective probes and elicits more informative responses than generic probing.
evidence_statement: Market researchers rated 69% of 300 generated probes as 4/5 or 5/5; 76% of responses to SmartProbe were rated 4/5 or 5/5 versus 25% under generic probing in parallel samples of 500 and 457.
reviewer_interpretation: The results support respondent-specific probing, but proprietary in-house ratings, bundled platforms, and nonrandom parallel samples limit causal and independent-validity claims.
